10k.note: Medical-device company (high-definition thin-film electrodes for neurological diagnosis/treatment). Commercial products cleared via 510(k); pipeline programs (Drug Delivery & monitoring electrode, SCS spinal cord stim, BVNA) are at benchtop/animal pre-clinical stage with potential 510(k) pathway — no active company-sponsored P1-P3 clinical trials disclosed.

website.note: Corporate site describes commercial Evo sEEG, OneRF ablation system, and Evo Cortical devices; no clinical-trial pipeline page.

ctgov.note: One raw record returned by sponsor query but none are active P1-P3 interventional trials sponsored by NeuroOne.

products: Evo sEEG Electrode (FDA-cleared <30-day stereoelectroencephalography depth electrode for epilepsy/Parkinson's monitoring)
OneRF Ablation System (FDA-cleared RF ablation using Evo sEEG-RF Probe; first nervous-tissue RF ablation system of its kind)
Evo Cortical Electrode (FDA-cleared minimally invasive cortical recording/stim electrode)
commercial_product.distribution: Exclusive global distribution of strip/grid cortical electrodes, electrode cable assemblies, and sEEG depth electrodes through Zimmer Biomet (agreement dated July 20, 2020).

excluded_preclinical: Drug Delivery and monitoring electrode (benchtop and animal studies; potential 510(k) for brain-cancer drug delivery system)
SCS - Spinal cord stimulation electrodes / percutaneous delivery system (benchtop, animal, cadaver studies; design not finalized)
BVNA (benchtop and animal ex-vivo studies; potential 510(k))
no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medical-device company. Commercial neurology electrode products (Evo sEEG, OneRF, Evo Cortical) are FDA-cleared via 510(k) and not in active drug-style P1-P3 clinical trials; remaining pipeline programs (drug-delivery electrode, SCS, BVNA) are at benchtop/animal pre-clinical stage with 510(k) regulatory pathway. No active company-sponsored P1-P3 interventional trials registered on ClinicalTrials.gov.
